name: Promax Auto Parts Depot
old_description: Today, ProMax is one of North America’s leading manufacturers and distributors of automotive aftermarket products. We specialize in disc brake pads, brake shoes, rotors, drums and chassis parts. ProMax products are engineered to the highest standards to provide maximum safety in every situation, whether it’s cruising along the highway or in stop-and-go city traffic. Our products deliver superior performance in a wide range of driving and weather conditions.
about:
Based in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, ProMax Auto Parts Depot operates as a manufacturer and distributor of automotive aftermarket products. The company describes itself as one of North America’s leading suppliers in this category, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

ProMax specializes in disc brake pads, brake shoes, rotors, drums, and chassis parts. The company produces these components for the automotive aftermarket, though specific manufacturing processes, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not detailed in available sources.

The company serves the North American automotive aftermarket, supplying repair shops, distributors, and retailers with replacement braking and chassis components. No specific customer names or industry segments beyond the general aftermarket are provided.

ProMax states that its products are engineered to the highest standards to deliver maximum safety and superior performance across a wide range of driving and weather conditions. This emphasis on safety and all-condition reliability is presented as the company’s core differentiation.
